pageTitle: Mastering Conflict & Negotiation | Tirwin Talent
heading: Program Overview
content: An Executive 6-Hour B2B Masterclass Tailored for Emerging Leaders in Logistics & Supply Chain Operations. Turn Operational Friction into Business Advantage. Standard leadership workshops focus on abstract corporate communication and fail in logistics because they ignore high-pressure operational friction—such as warehouse SLA breaches, vessel demurrage disputes, and carrier freight rate pinches. This program transforms conflict into operational efficiency, equipping mid-level managers with domain-tailored negotiation tactics to directly reduce SLA delays, protect vendor margins, and avoid multi-party disputes.
